metadata.description: AST-expansion conformance fixture for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2y_6_neumann_bc: a minimal consuming model binding NX=4, NY=8 at the import edge. The compound match D(D(u,y),y) fires (priority 10) through the section-9.6.3 fixpoint and lowers to the rule's makearray — interior rows [4,5] (all i) holding the imported 7-point sixth-order y second-difference stencil aggregate, the six y-face rows j in {1,2,3,6,7,8} over the (NX x 1) strips holding the sixth-order one-sided neumann closures (face1/face2/face3) carrying the free names qYL, qYR and dy — with all metaparameters folded. x0=y0=0 and dx=1/4, dy=1/8; the dx/dy expressions are spelled with literals because the edge binding closes NX/NY before this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm). The golden pins the byte-identical post-lowering AST across bindings.
metadata.name: central_D2y_6_neumann_bc_ast_fixture

central_D2y_6_neumann_face1.description: D2 = (-13547520 q dy - 4382308 f1 - 18097596 f2 + 45297765 f3 - 35955160 f4 + 17356770 f5 - 4804812 f6 + 585341 f7) / (15852420 dy^2). q is the y-wall derivative datum entering this low-wall closure (bind q -> -qYR at the high wall); f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

central_D2y_6_neumann_face2.description: D2 = (1182720 q dy + 18691149 f1 - 35446775 f2 + 14068125 f3 + 5473470 f4 - 3779905 f5 + 1136601 f6 - 142665 f7) / (15852420 dy^2). q is the y-wall derivative datum entering this low-wall closure (bind q -> -qYR at the high wall); f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

central_D2y_6_neumann_face3.description: D2 = (-215040 q dy - 2349569 f1 + 24170756 f2 - 43630020 f3 + 24144520 f4 - 2555285 f5 + 225684 f6 - 6086 f7) / (15852420 dy^2). q is the y-wall derivative datum entering this low-wall closure (bind q -> -qYR at the high wall); f1..f7 are the seven cells (fixed i) in order of increasing distance from the wall.

x_coord.description: Cell-center x-coordinates x_i = x0 + (i - 1/2) dx, shaped over the x index set. x0 and dx are free names supplied by the consuming model (see metadata.description for the contract).

y_coord.description: Cell-center y-coordinates y_j = y0 + (j - 1/2) dy, shaped over the y index set. y0 and dy are free names supplied by the consuming model (see metadata.description for the contract).

dx.description: x-spacing 1/NX = 1/4, spelled with the literal 4: the import edge binds NX, closing it before this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm contract).

dy.description: y-spacing 1/NY = 1/8, spelled with the literal 8: the import edge binds NY.

qYL.description: df/dy at the bottom y-wall (the rule's Neumann free name). Zero default = homogeneous (zero-flux) bottom wall.

qYR.description: df/dy at the top y-wall (the rule's Neumann free name), nonzero so the inhomogeneous face flux term appears in the expanded golden.

u.description: Temperature field over the 2-D [x, y] index sets.

x0.description: Left x domain edge a = 0: the grid's x0 free name (consumer-supplied geometry contract).

y0.description: Bottom y domain edge: the grid's y0 free name.
